summary: Short, non-interactive label for statuses, categories or counts.
whenToUse: Counts next to tabs or menu items.
whenNotToUse: Removable or selectable items: use Tag.
Messages that require action: use Alert or Banner.
accessibility: The meaning must be in the text: color, dot and icon are decorative.
For a standalone count, add context (e.g. an aria-label on the container or hidden text: “4 notifications”).
responsive: Single-line text with an ellipsis when space is insufficient.
commonMistakes: Using color alone to distinguish statuses.
Making a Badge clickable: use Button or Tag.
